blocks.zh: 設備設計、確效與持續管控
blocks.en: Equipment Design, Validation, and Ongoing Control

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解設備設計如何作為 Contamination Control Strategy (CCS) 污染控制策略的核心要素，並掌握「整體性方法 (Holistic Approach)」的思維模式
blocks.en: Understand how equipment design serves as a core element of the Contamination Control Strategy (CCS), and adopt the mindset of a "Holistic Approach"

blocks.zh: 掌握設備設計階段應考量的關鍵項目清單，包括封閉系統、衛生級設計、屏障技術與互鎖機制
blocks.en: Master the key items to consider at the equipment design stage, including closed systems, hygienic design, barrier technology, and interlocks

blocks.zh: 認識 Cleaning Validation (清潔確效) 的侷限性，特別是 Biofilm (生物膜) 對清潔效果的長期影響
blocks.en: Recognize the limitations of cleaning validation, especially the long-term effect of biofilm on cleaning effectiveness

blocks.zh: 學習設備持續管控階段的查核要點，包括清潔狀態識別、無菌保持時間、RABS 門開啟管理
blocks.en: Learn the key checkpoints in the ongoing control of equipment, including cleanliness status identification, sterile hold time, and RABS door opening management

blocks.zh: 了解 Single-Use Systems (一次性使用系統)、Barrier Technology (屏障技術)、Product Pathway (產品路徑) 的特殊考量
blocks.en: Understand the special considerations for Single-Use Systems (SUS), barrier technology, and the product pathway

blocks.zh: 掌握設備維護 (Maintenance) 在 CCS 中的角色，包括預防性維護計畫、Temporary Gray Space Enclosure (TGSE) 的管控策略
blocks.en: Master the role of equipment maintenance in the CCS, including the preventive maintenance program and the control strategy for a Temporary Gray Space Enclosure (TGSE)

blocks.zh: 9.0 Equipment Design, Validation, and Ongoing Control 9.0 設備設計、驗證與持續管制
blocks.en: 9.0 Equipment Design, Validation, and Ongoing Control

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Holistic Approach (整體性方法)：TR90 在此強調設備管控不是一個個獨立的檢查點，而是「設計 → 確效 → 日常管控」三者如同鏈條般環環相扣。任何一個環節的疏忽，都可能讓其他環節的努力功虧一簣。
blocks.en: Holistic Approach: TR90 stresses here that equipment control is not a series of independent checkpoints. Design, validation, and day-to-day control are linked like a chain, and neglect at any one link can undo the effort invested in the others.

blocks.zh: CCS 中的設備角色：設備是 CCS 架構中「硬體防線」的核心。與人員管控 (Section 8.0)、環境管控 (Section 7.0) 並列為三大支柱。設備設計得好，可以大幅降低對人員操作和環境控制的依賴。
blocks.en: The role of equipment in the CCS: Equipment is the core of the "hardware defense" in the CCS architecture. Together with personnel control (Section 8.0) and environmental control (Section 7.0), it forms one of the three pillars. Well-designed equipment greatly reduces the reliance on operator technique and environmental control.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像蓋一棟醫院：「非整體性方法」就像只關心手術室的無菌，卻忽略了從大門到手術室的走廊、電梯、空調是否也做好了感染管控。「整體性方法」則是從建築設計階段就規劃好動線、空氣流向、清潔區域劃分，讓每個環節都互相支援，不留死角。
blocks.en: Imagine building a hospital. A "non-holistic approach" is like caring only about sterility in the operating room while ignoring whether the corridors, elevators, and air conditioning between the main entrance and the operating room are also under infection control. A "holistic approach" plans the traffic flow, airflow direction, and cleanliness zoning from the architectural design stage, so that every element supports the others and leaves no blind spots.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: Table 9.0-1🔍 的核心訊息：「清潔已確效」不代表萬事大吉。確效只是在特定條件下驗證了清潔程序的有效性，但實際操作中的 hold time 超標、殘留水分等情境，都可能讓已確效的清潔程序失效。Biofilm (生物膜) 一旦形成，移除難度將大幅增加。
blocks.en: The core message of Table 9.0-1🔍: "Cleaning validated" does not mean everything is fine. Validation only demonstrates the effectiveness of the cleaning procedure under specific conditions. In actual operation, situations such as exceeded hold times or residual moisture can render a validated cleaning procedure ineffective. Once a biofilm has formed, it becomes far more difficult to remove.

blocks.zh: 這正是 EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) 的精神：不能僅依賴驗證結果，必須以風險為導向持續監控。
blocks.en: This is exactly the spirit of EU GMP Annex 1 (2022): you cannot rely on validation results alone; you must monitor continuously on a risk basis.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 在你的工廠中，設備清潔確效後是否曾因 hold time 超標而直接放行？這樣做的風險是什麼？
blocks.en: In your facility, has equipment ever been released directly after cleaning validation despite an exceeded hold time? What is the risk of doing so?

blocks.zh: 請試著列出你工廠中一個「非整體性」的設備管控案例，並思考如何改善為「整體性」方法。
blocks.en: List one example of "non-holistic" equipment control in your facility, and consider how to improve it into a "holistic" approach.

blocks.zh: 9.1 Equipment Design 9.1 設備設計
blocks.en: 9.1 Equipment Design

blocks.zh: 設計決定成本 (Design Drives Cost)：TR90 開宗明義指出，如果設備設計階段未能有效控制污染風險，後續就必須用更多的 SOP、無菌工具、區隔措施和更短的 hold time 來彌補。這些補救措施不僅增加營運成本，也增加了產品生命週期內的風險。
blocks.en: Design Drives Cost: TR90 states at the outset that if contamination risk is not effectively controlled at the equipment design stage, it must later be compensated for with more SOPs, aseptic tools, segregation measures, and shorter hold times. These remedial measures not only increase operating costs but also increase risk over the product lifecycle.

blocks.zh: Closed System (封閉系統)：設備盡可能設計為封閉系統是首要原則。封閉系統意味著產品不會暴露於外部環境，從源頭消除了微生物和粒子污染的風險。
blocks.en: Closed System: Designing equipment as a closed system wherever possible is the first principle. A closed system means the product is not exposed to the external environment, eliminating the risk of microbial and particulate contamination at the source.

blocks.zh: Interlock (互鎖機制)：屏障設備上的互鎖裝置可以防止操作員犯錯（如在不當時機開門）或警告設備元件故障。這是「設備防呆」的具體體現。
blocks.en: Interlock: Interlocks on barrier equipment can prevent operator errors (such as opening a door at the wrong time) or warn of equipment component failure. This is a concrete embodiment of "equipment error-proofing."

blocks.zh: 設備設計就像蓋房子的地基和結構。如果地基沒打好（設備設計不佳），後續就得不斷加裝警報系統、安排更多保全（更多 SOP、更多監控），但房子還是不穩。反之，地基穩固的房子（良好的設備設計），後續維護簡單、住起來安心。在製藥業，這個差異可能意味著每批次數十萬到數百萬的成本差異。
blocks.en: Equipment design is like the foundation and structure of a house. If the foundation is poor (poor equipment design), you must keep adding alarm systems and hiring more security guards (more SOPs, more monitoring), and the house is still unstable. A house with a solid foundation (good equipment design), on the other hand, is easy to maintain and comfortable to live in. In the pharmaceutical industry, this difference can mean hundreds of thousands to millions in cost per batch.

blocks.zh: Manual and Open 的代價：如果某個製程步驟選擇了「手動且開放」的設計，TR90 明確指出必須「全面強化」周圍的所有管控措施。這包括：
blocks.en: The Cost of Manual and Open: If a process step is designed as "manual and open," TR90 clearly states that all surrounding controls must be "comprehensively strengthened." This includes:

blocks.zh: 加強人員管控（更嚴格的更衣、行為規範）
blocks.en: Strengthen personnel controls (stricter gowning and behavior rules)

blocks.zh: 加強環境管控（更高等級的清潔、氣流管理）
blocks.en: Strengthen environmental controls (higher-grade cleaning, airflow management)

blocks.zh: 增加品質測試/監控頻率
blocks.en: Increase the frequency of quality testing/monitoring

blocks.zh: 每次執行該步驟都必須進行 EM (Environmental Monitoring，環境監測)
blocks.en: Perform EM (Environmental Monitoring) every time the step is executed

blocks.zh: 從開發階段到商業化階段，CCS 都應持續重新評估以改善管控。
blocks.en: From the development stage through the commercial stage, the CCS should be continuously re-evaluated to improve control.

blocks.zh: 設計查核清單重點歸納
blocks.en: Key Takeaways from the Design Checklist

blocks.zh: TR90 列出的 18 項設計考量可歸納為四大原則：
blocks.en: The 18 design considerations listed in TR90 can be summarized into four principles:

blocks.zh: 隔離原則：封閉系統、屏障設備、互鎖機制、減少人員介入
blocks.en: Isolation principle: closed systems, barrier equipment, interlocks, reduced human intervention

blocks.zh: 可清潔原則：光滑表面、衛生級材料 (316SS)、排水坡度、密封貫穿口
blocks.en: Cleanability principle: smooth surfaces, hygienic-grade materials (316SS), drainage slope, sealed penetrations

blocks.zh: 可監控原則：固定探頭位置、Alert/Action 警報條件、電子設備可擦拭
blocks.en: Monitorability principle: fixed probe positions, Alert/Action alarm conditions, wipeable electronic equipment

blocks.zh: 可維護原則：機械/電氣調整在無菌區外進行、設備可輕鬆保護儲存
blocks.en: Maintainability principle: mechanical/electrical adjustments made outside the aseptic area, equipment easy to store under protection

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 場景：你的 CDMO 正在評估引進新的充填線。客戶要求的產品需要一個開放式手動加料步驟。根據 TR90 的指導，你應該：
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: Your CDMO is evaluating the introduction of a new filling line. The client's product requires an open, manual addition step. Following TR90 guidance, you should:

blocks.zh: 首先評估是否可以改為封閉系統設計來消除此步驟
blocks.en: First assess whether the step can be eliminated by changing to a closed system design

blocks.zh: 如果無法避免，應計算「全面強化管控」的額外成本（人員、EM、QC 測試）
blocks.en: If it cannot be avoided, calculate the additional cost of "comprehensively strengthened control" (personnel, EM, QC testing)

blocks.zh: 將此成本回饋給客戶的報價，或建議客戶投資封閉系統以降低長期營運成本
blocks.en: Pass this cost on in the quotation to the client, or suggest that the client invest in a closed system to reduce long-term operating costs

blocks.zh: 你的充填線上，autoclaves 的 air-break filter 進氣來源是潔淨室還是廠房區域？如果來自廠房區域，風險是什麼？
blocks.en: On your filling line, is the air-break filter intake of the autoclaves sourced from the cleanroom or from the plant area? If from the plant area, what is the risk?

blocks.zh: 列出三個你的設備上「不符合」TR90 設計清單要求的項目，並提出改善建議。
blocks.en: List three items on your equipment that do not meet the TR90 design checklist, and propose improvements.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR90 要求「零件應設計為可作為一個單元滅菌」而非在現場逐一連接？
blocks.en: Why does TR90 require that "parts should be designed to be sterilized as one unit" rather than connected one by one on site?

blocks.zh: 9.2 Equipment Cleaning Validation 9.2 設備清潔驗證
blocks.en: 9.2 Equipment Cleaning Validation

blocks.zh: Cleaning Validation (清潔確效) 的侷限性：TR90 在此提出了一個很重要但常被忽視的觀點 — 清潔確效是必要的，但其預測設備整個使用壽命內微生物控制效果的能力是有限的。原因包括：
blocks.en: Limitations of Cleaning Validation: TR90 raises an important but often overlooked point here: cleaning validation is necessary, but its ability to predict microbial control over the entire service life of the equipment is limited. The reasons include:

blocks.zh: 確效時機和測試量有限（通常只做 3 批）
blocks.en: Validation is limited in timing and test volume (usually only 3 batches)

blocks.zh: 傳統微生物測試方法的偵測能力有限
blocks.en: Traditional microbial test methods have limited detection capability

blocks.zh: 確效通常在新設備上進行，未接觸到長期使用的各種劣化因素
blocks.en: Validation is usually performed on new equipment, which has not yet been exposed to the various degradation factors of long-term use

blocks.zh: Biofilm (生物膜)：微生物在設備表面形成的保護性群落結構。一旦形成，其對清潔劑和消毒劑的抵抗力會大幅增強，使常規清潔程序失效。
blocks.en: Biofilm: A protective community structure formed by microorganisms on equipment surfaces. Once formed, its resistance to cleaning agents and disinfectants increases substantially, making routine cleaning procedures ineffective.

blocks.zh: 清潔確效就像汽車的新車出廠檢測 — 新車時一切指標都完美，但你不能因此就認為這輛車永遠不需要保養。隨著使用年限增加，引擎積碳 (= residue build-up)、橡膠老化 (= surface damage)、甚至遇到特殊路況 (= worst-case biofilm organism) 都可能讓原本有效的保養程序不再足夠。Biofilm 就像水管裡的水垢 — 一旦形成就很難徹底清除，而且會越積越厚。
blocks.en: Cleaning validation is like the factory inspection of a new car: every indicator is perfect when the car is new, but you cannot conclude that it will never need servicing. As the car ages, carbon build-up in the engine (= residue build-up), rubber aging (= surface damage), and even unusual road conditions (= worst-case biofilm organism) can make a previously effective maintenance routine insufficient. Biofilm is like limescale in a water pipe: once formed it is hard to remove completely, and it keeps getting thicker.

blocks.zh: Arthrobacter russicus 案例：TR90 特別點名這個微生物，它能在低營養環境中僅三天就形成難以去除的 biofilm。這個案例說明：
blocks.en: The Arthrobacter russicus case: TR90 specifically names this microorganism, which can form a hard-to-remove biofilm in a low-nutrient environment in only three days. This case shows that:

blocks.zh: 你的清潔程序可能有效運行多年，直到遇到一個 worst-case 的 biofilm 形成菌
blocks.en: Your cleaning procedure may work effectively for years, until it meets a worst-case biofilm-forming organism

blocks.zh: 不能因為「從未出過問題」就認為清潔程序永遠足夠
blocks.en: You cannot assume the cleaning procedure will always be adequate just because "there has never been a problem"

blocks.zh: Clean hold time 的管控至關重要 — 任何殘留水分都可能成為 biofilm 的溫床
blocks.en: Control of clean hold time is critical, because any residual moisture can become a breeding ground for biofilm

blocks.zh: 交叉參考：PDA TR69 (biofilm 預防)、PDA TR29 和 TR49 (清潔確效) 提供了更詳細的指引。
blocks.en: Cross-references: PDA TR69 (biofilm prevention) and PDA TR29 and TR49 (cleaning validation) provide more detailed guidance.

blocks.zh: 影響清潔有效性的因素矩陣
blocks.en: Matrix of Factors Affecting Cleaning Effectiveness

blocks.zh:
清潔有效性下降因素：
  1. Biofilm-producing organisms (生物膜生成菌)
  2. Years of residue build-up (多年殘留物累積)
  3. Normal wear (正常磨損)
  4. Surface damage (表面損傷)

風險公式概念：
  實際清潔風險 = f(設備使用年限, 產品殘留特性,
                    微生物種類, 表面狀態, hold time 管控)

  確效結論有效性 ∝ 1 / (設備年齡 + 累積使用次數)
blocks.en:
Factors that reduce cleaning effectiveness:
  1. Biofilm-producing organisms
  2. Years of residue build-up
  3. Normal wear
  4. Surface damage

Conceptual risk formula:
  Actual cleaning risk = f(equipment age, product residue characteristics,
                    microorganism type, surface condition, hold time control)

  Validity of validation conclusion ∝ 1 / (equipment age + cumulative number of uses)

blocks.zh: 你的工廠是否有針對設備表面狀態進行定期視覺檢查的 SOP？如果設備使用超過 5 年，你會如何調整清潔確效策略？
blocks.en: Does your facility have an SOP for periodic visual inspection of equipment surface condition? If equipment has been in use for more than 5 years, how would you adjust your cleaning validation strategy?

blocks.zh: 假設你的環境監測發現了 Arthrobacter 屬微生物，你應該啟動哪些調查和因應措施？
blocks.en: Suppose your environmental monitoring detects Arthrobacter species. What investigations and response actions should you initiate?

blocks.zh: 傳統清潔確效主要聚焦於產品殘留物去除，請說明為什麼這不足以預防 biofilm 形成。
blocks.en: Traditional cleaning validation focuses mainly on removal of product residues. Explain why this is not sufficient to prevent biofilm formation.

blocks.zh: 9.3 Equipment Ongoing Control 9.3 設備持續管制
blocks.en: 9.3 Equipment Ongoing Control

blocks.zh: Reservoir for Microbial Contamination (微生物污染儲存庫)：設備如果管控不善，不僅會成為一次性的污染源，更會成為持續性的微生物「巢穴」。Biofilm 一旦在設備內壁或管路中形成，就會持續釋放微生物進入製程流中，成為反覆出現的污染根源。
blocks.en: Reservoir for Microbial Contamination: Poorly controlled equipment becomes not just a one-time source of contamination but a persistent microbial "nest." Once a biofilm forms on the inner walls of equipment or in piping, it continuously releases microorganisms into the process stream and becomes the root of recurring contamination.

blocks.zh: Clean Hold Time (潔淨保持時間)：設備清潔/滅菌後到使用前的最大允許放置時間
blocks.en: Clean Hold Time: The maximum permitted time between cleaning/sterilization of equipment and its use

blocks.zh: Dirty Hold Time (髒污保持時間)：設備使用完畢後到開始清潔前的最大允許放置時間
blocks.en: Dirty Hold Time: The maximum permitted time between the end of equipment use and the start of cleaning

blocks.zh: 兩者都必須經過確效，因為超過任何一個時間限制都可能導致微生物增殖或 biofilm 形成。
blocks.en: Both must be validated, because exceeding either time limit can lead to microbial proliferation or biofilm formation.

blocks.zh: 設備的持續管控就像家裡的冰箱管理：
blocks.en: Ongoing equipment control is like managing a household refrigerator:

blocks.zh: Clean hold time = 食物的保存期限標籤（過期就不能用）
blocks.en: Clean hold time = the expiry date label on food (once expired, it cannot be used)

blocks.zh: Dirty hold time = 碗盤不能放在水槽太久不洗（會長黴菌）
blocks.en: Dirty hold time = dishes must not sit in the sink too long without washing (they grow mold)

blocks.zh: Status label = 冰箱裡食物的日期標籤（清楚標示狀態）
blocks.en: Status label = the date label on food in the refrigerator (clearly shows the status)

blocks.zh: Unexpected condensate = 食物包裝出現水滴（可能已經變質）
blocks.en: Unexpected condensate = water droplets on food packaging (the food may have spoiled)

blocks.zh: Color-change indicator = 雞蛋的新鮮度檢測器（一眼就知道狀態）
blocks.en: Color-change indicator = an egg freshness tester (you know the status at a glance)

blocks.zh: 12 項查核要點可歸納為五大管控領域：
blocks.en: The 12 checkpoints can be grouped into five control areas:

blocks.zh: 狀態管控：清潔/滅菌狀態標示、有色變色指示劑、目視確認乾燥
blocks.en: Status control: cleaned/sterilized status labeling, color-change indicators, visual confirmation of dryness

blocks.zh: 時間管控：Clean hold time、Dirty hold time、滅菌到使用的時間間隔
blocks.en: Time control: clean hold time, dirty hold time, time interval between sterilization and use

blocks.zh: 完整性管控：包裝破損即棄、預滅菌物料雙層包裝、RABS 門開啟控制
blocks.en: Integrity control: discard torn packaging, double-bagging of pre-sterilized materials, RABS door opening control

blocks.zh: 正壓管控：已滅菌儲槽維持正壓或密封
blocks.en: Positive pressure control: sterilized tanks kept under positive pressure or sealed

blocks.zh: 轉運管控：設備儲存與返回製造區的轉運計畫
blocks.en: Transfer control: equipment storage and transfer plan for return to the manufacturing area

blocks.zh: RABS 門開啟管控
blocks.en: RABS Door Opening Control

blocks.zh: TR90 特別提到 RABS 門只能在必要時開啟，且持續時間應盡可能短，並且需要有經過確效的氣流 Recovery Time (恢復時間)。這意味著每次開門後，都需要等待氣流恢復到合格狀態。這是 EU GMP Annex 1 對 RABS 操作的核心要求之一。
blocks.en: TR90 specifically notes that RABS doors should be opened only when necessary, for as short a duration as possible, and that a validated airflow Recovery Time is needed. This means that after each door opening, you must wait for the airflow to return to a qualified state. This is one of the core requirements of EU GMP Annex 1 for RABS operation.

blocks.zh: CDMO 場景：你的工廠剛完成一批充填，下一批需要等待 16 小時後才開始。操作員在收工時清潔了設備並貼上「已清潔」標籤。根據 TR90 的管控要求，你應確保：
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: Your facility has just finished a filling batch, and the next batch will not start for 16 hours. The operator cleaned the equipment at the end of the shift and attached a "Cleaned" label. Under the TR90 control requirements, you should ensure that:

blocks.zh: 「已清潔」標籤上包含清潔日期/時間，操作員可以對照 Clean hold time
blocks.en: The "Cleaned" label includes the cleaning date/time so that the operator can check against the clean hold time

blocks.zh: 設備在包裝/覆蓋前已視覺確認乾燥
blocks.en: The equipment was visually confirmed to be dry before it was wrapped/covered

blocks.zh: 如果 Clean hold time 在下一批開始前會超標，應重新清潔/滅菌
blocks.en: If the clean hold time would be exceeded before the next batch starts, the equipment is re-cleaned/re-sterilized

blocks.zh: 設備儲存區域有防止污染引入的管控措施
blocks.en: The equipment storage area has controls to prevent the introduction of contamination

blocks.zh: 你的工廠如何區分已滅菌和未滅菌的設備？除了 color-change indicator，還有哪些方法？
blocks.en: How does your facility distinguish sterilized from unsterilized equipment? Besides color-change indicators, what other methods are there?

blocks.zh: 如果一個已滅菌的零件包裝上發現了一個小破洞但零件看起來很乾淨，你會怎麼處理？為什麼？
blocks.en: If a small hole is found in the packaging of a sterilized part but the part looks clean, how would you handle it? Why?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR90 要求「濕的零件不應使用」？水分與微生物污染之間的關係是什麼？
blocks.en: Why does TR90 require that "wet parts should not be used"? What is the relationship between moisture and microbial contamination?

blocks.zh: 9.4 Special Equipment Considerations 9.4 特殊設備考量
blocks.en: 9.4 Special Equipment Considerations

blocks.zh: Single-Use Systems, SUS (一次性使用系統)：SUS 的最大優勢在於提供封閉式製造環境，消除了 CIP/SIP 的需求以及交叉污染的風險。但 TR90 也指出其核心風險 — 通常無法在使用前和使用後進行 leak/integrity testing。
blocks.en: Single-Use Systems (SUS): The greatest advantage of SUS is that they provide a closed manufacturing environment, eliminating the need for CIP/SIP and the risk of cross-contamination. TR90 also points out their core risk: it is usually not possible to perform leak/integrity testing before and after use.

blocks.zh: Tube Welder (管路焊接機)：用於在不破壞無菌產品路徑的前提下連接不同的 SUS。焊接品質直接影響產品路徑的完整性，因此刀片/晶片的定期更換和焊接接頭的使用前檢查至關重要。
blocks.en: Tube Welder: Used to connect different SUS without breaking the sterile product pathway. Weld quality directly affects the integrity of the product pathway, so regular replacement of the blade/wafer and pre-use inspection of weld joints are essential.

blocks.zh: Barrier Separation Technology (屏障隔離技術)：對於無法完全封閉的操作，isolator (隔離器) 和 RABS (限制進出屏障系統) 是 CCS 的首選方案。核心目的是將操作員與製程分離。
blocks.en: Barrier Separation Technology: For operations that cannot be fully enclosed, isolators and RABS (Restricted Access Barrier Systems) are the preferred solutions in the CCS. The core purpose is to separate the operator from the process.

blocks.zh: Product Pathway (產品路徑)：產品在系統中暴露的環境。進行 closure risk analysis (封閉性風險分析) 是評估產品路徑污染風險的關鍵方法。
blocks.en: Product Pathway: The environment to which the product is exposed within the system. Performing a closure risk analysis is the key method for assessing the contamination risk of the product pathway.

blocks.zh: SUS = 免洗餐具：就像餐廳使用免洗餐具可以消除洗碗不乾淨的風險，但你必須確保包裝是完整的（沒有破洞），而且要在使用前檢查。SUS 的挑戰在於 — 有些「包裝」你無法在使用前完全測試其密封性。
blocks.en: SUS = disposable tableware: Just as a restaurant using disposable tableware eliminates the risk of poorly washed dishes, you must make sure the packaging is intact (no holes) and check it before use. The challenge with SUS is that for some of the "packaging," you cannot fully test its seal integrity before use.

blocks.zh: Barrier Technology = 太空站的操作手套：太空人透過太空站的專用手套箱操作危險材料，手套的位置必須設計在合理的操作角度，避免太空人必須「彎腰越過」操作對象。同樣，isolator/RABS 的手套位置設計必須避免操作員需要跨越無菌產品或零件。
blocks.en: Barrier Technology = space station glove box: Astronauts handle hazardous materials through dedicated glove boxes on the space station, and the glove positions must be designed at reasonable working angles so that astronauts do not have to "lean over" the object they are handling. Likewise, the glove positions of an isolator/RABS must be designed so that the operator does not need to reach over sterile product or parts.

blocks.zh: SUS 的關鍵管控點：
blocks.en: Key control points for SUS:

blocks.zh: 接收時確認滅菌週期資料
blocks.en: Confirm sterilization cycle data on receipt

blocks.zh: 使用前和使用中觀察是否有洩漏或破洞
blocks.en: Observe for leaks or holes before and during use

blocks.zh: Tube welder 的正確使用技術和維護
blocks.en: Correct use technique and maintenance of the tube welder

blocks.zh: 焊接接頭在使用前必須檢查
blocks.en: Weld joints must be inspected before use

blocks.zh: Glove Test Strategy (手套測試策略)：對於 isolator 和 RABS，必須定義結合目視檢查和物理洩漏測試的手套測試策略。手套是屏障系統中最脆弱的環節，任何針孔洩漏都可能破壞無菌環境。
blocks.en: Glove Test Strategy: For isolators and RABS, a glove test strategy combining visual inspection and physical leak testing must be defined. Gloves are the weakest link in a barrier system, and any pinhole leak can compromise the aseptic environment.

blocks.zh: Product Pathway 風險層級：Closed system (最低風險) > Sterile-to-sterile connection > SUS/RTP > Open step (最高風險)。任何開放步驟都應評估是否可以改善為更低風險的選項。
blocks.en: Product Pathway risk hierarchy: Closed system (lowest risk) > Sterile-to-sterile connection > SUS/RTP > Open step (highest risk). Any open step should be evaluated for whether it can be improved to a lower-risk option.

blocks.zh: CDMO 場景：你的工廠使用 SUS 進行藥液配製，並透過 tube welder 連接到無菌過濾系統。最近發生了一次微生物偏差，調查顯示焊接接頭處有微小滲漏。你應該：
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: Your facility uses SUS for solution preparation and connects to the sterile filtration system with a tube welder. A microbial deviation recently occurred, and the investigation showed a minor leak at the weld joint. You should:

blocks.zh: 立即確認 tube welder 的維護紀錄（刀片/晶片是否按時更換）
blocks.en: Immediately check the tube welder maintenance records (were the blade/wafer replaced on schedule?)

blocks.zh: 檢討焊接操作 SOP 和操作員訓練紀錄
blocks.en: Review the welding SOP and operator training records

blocks.zh: 評估是否增加焊接接頭的使用前目視/物理檢查頻率
blocks.en: Evaluate whether to increase the frequency of pre-use visual/physical inspection of weld joints

blocks.zh: 考慮與供應商合作開發使用前完整性測試方法
blocks.en: Consider working with the supplier to develop a pre-use integrity test method

blocks.zh: 你的工廠使用 isolator 還是 RABS？請比較兩者在操作彈性和污染風險方面的差異。
blocks.en: Does your facility use isolators or RABS? Compare the two in terms of operational flexibility and contamination risk.

blocks.zh: 在產品路徑的 closure risk analysis 中，你會如何評估一個「每批需要手動取樣」的步驟？提出至少兩個降低風險的改善方案。
blocks.en: In a closure risk analysis of the product pathway, how would you assess a step that requires manual sampling for every batch? Propose at least two improvements to reduce the risk.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR90 強調 glove 的位置設計不應要求操作員跨越無菌產品？這與 Section 8.0 的人員管控有什麼關聯？
blocks.en: Why does TR90 emphasize that glove position design should not require the operator to reach over sterile product? How does this relate to the personnel controls in Section 8.0?

blocks.zh: 9.5 Maintenance 9.5 維護保養
blocks.en: 9.5 Maintenance

blocks.zh: Maintenance (維護) 的雙面性：TR90 揭示了維護活動的矛盾本質 — 定期維護可以預防設備故障和污染，但維護活動本身如果管控不當，也可能引入污染。這就是為什麼維護策略必須與 CCS 整合。
blocks.en: The Dual Nature of Maintenance: TR90 reveals the inherent contradiction of maintenance activities: regular maintenance can prevent equipment failure and contamination, but maintenance activities themselves, if poorly controlled, can also introduce contamination. This is why the maintenance strategy must be integrated with the CCS.

blocks.zh: Gray Space (灰色空間)：建在潔淨區旁邊的非分級區域，讓維護人員可以從後方接觸設備，而不需要進入潔淨區。這是「設計消除風險」的最佳實踐。
blocks.en: Gray Space: A non-classified area built next to the cleanroom so that maintenance personnel can access equipment from behind without entering the cleanroom. This is a best practice of "eliminating risk through design."

blocks.zh: TGSE — Temporary Gray Space Enclosure (臨時灰色空間圍封)：當潔淨室的部分區域需要進行維護時，可以建立臨時圍封而不是關閉整個潔淨室。這是在「維護需求」和「生產連續性」之間的平衡方案。
blocks.en: TGSE - Temporary Gray Space Enclosure: When part of a cleanroom needs maintenance, a temporary enclosure can be set up instead of shutting down the entire cleanroom. This is a compromise between "maintenance needs" and "production continuity."

blocks.zh: Rouging (紅鏽)：不鏽鋼設備表面因長期使用而產生的鐵氧化物沉積。會導致粒子污染並降低清潔效果。
blocks.en: Rouging: Iron oxide deposits that form on stainless steel equipment surfaces through long-term use. They cause particulate contamination and reduce cleaning effectiveness.

blocks.zh: TGSE = 餐廳裝修時的臨時隔板：想像一家仍在營業的餐廳需要翻修廚房的一角。餐廳不會整間關門，而是用臨時隔板將施工區域與用餐區和其他廚房區域隔開。但這需要：
blocks.en: TGSE = temporary partition during restaurant renovation: Imagine a restaurant that is still open needing to renovate one corner of its kitchen. The restaurant does not close entirely; it uses temporary partitions to separate the construction area from the dining area and the rest of the kitchen. But this requires:

blocks.zh: 確保隔板密封良好（= 壓差監測）
blocks.en: The partition is well sealed (= pressure differential monitoring)

blocks.zh: 施工人員有專用進出通道（= 定義交通動線）
blocks.en: Construction workers have a dedicated entry and exit route (= defined traffic flow)

blocks.zh: 施工人員穿戴防護裝備（= 更衣程序）
blocks.en: Construction workers wear protective equipment (= gowning procedure)

blocks.zh: 隔板周圍加強清潔（= 增加清潔消毒頻率）
blocks.en: Enhanced cleaning around the partition (= increased cleaning and disinfection frequency)

blocks.zh: 施工完成後徹底清潔消毒才能恢復使用（= triple-cleaning cycle + EM）
blocks.en: After construction, thorough cleaning and disinfection before the area is returned to use (= triple-cleaning cycle + EM)

blocks.zh: TGSE 管控要點清單：
blocks.en: TGSE control checklist:

blocks.zh: 定義人員進出動線
blocks.en: Define personnel entry and exit routes

blocks.zh: 監測壓差（TGSE 區域壓力必須低於周圍分級區域）
blocks.en: Monitor pressure differential (the TGSE area pressure must be lower than the surrounding classified area)

blocks.zh: 專用更衣/脫衣程序
blocks.en: Dedicated gowning/degowning procedure

blocks.zh: 增加周圍清潔消毒頻率
blocks.en: Increase the cleaning and disinfection frequency of the surrounding area

blocks.zh: 加強 EM 監測
blocks.en: Strengthen EM monitoring

blocks.zh: 最小化 TGSE 周圍的人員流動
blocks.en: Minimize personnel movement around the TGSE

blocks.zh: 建立區域恢復程序
blocks.en: Establish an area recovery procedure

blocks.zh: Triple-Cleaning and Disinfection Cycle (三次清潔消毒循環)：標準停機恢復做法。這不是一般的「清潔三次」，而是完整的「清潔 + 消毒」循環重複三次，之後還需要 EM 確認環境恢復合格才能放行。
blocks.en: Triple-Cleaning and Disinfection Cycle: The standard practice for recovery after a shutdown. This is not simply "cleaning three times" but a complete "cleaning + disinfection" cycle repeated three times, after which EM must confirm that the environment has returned to a qualified state before release.

blocks.zh: 彈性體零件管理
blocks.en: Management of Elastomeric Components

blocks.zh: TR90 特別強調 Elastomeric Components (彈性體零件)（墊圈、O-ring、隔膜、軟管等）的預防性維護計畫。這些零件是設備中最容易老化、劣化的部分，一旦失去密封功能就會成為污染入口。定期目視檢查產品接觸面可以早期偵測 rouging 或其他劣化，避免粒子污染和清潔效果下降。
blocks.en: TR90 particularly emphasizes the preventive maintenance program for Elastomeric Components (gaskets, O-rings, diaphragms, hoses, etc.). These parts are the most prone to aging and degradation in the equipment, and once they lose their sealing function they become a point of entry for contamination. Regular visual inspection of product-contact surfaces allows early detection of rouging or other degradation, avoiding particulate contamination and reduced cleaning effectiveness.

blocks.zh: 維護策略的風險平衡
blocks.en: Risk Balance in the Maintenance Strategy

blocks.zh:
維護策略考量：

  不做維護的風險：
    設備故障 → 非計畫停機 → 污染風險↑ → 產品損失

  維護本身的風險：
    開啟非常規區域 → 粒子/微生物釋放 → 環境污染

  最佳平衡點：
    預防性維護 (PM) > 矯正性維護 (CM)
    Gray space 設計 > 潔淨區內維護
    TGSE 區域隔離 > 整間潔淨室停機

  恢復標準：
    Triple clean/disinfect → EM 確認 → 放行
blocks.en:
Maintenance strategy considerations:

  Risk of not performing maintenance:
    Equipment failure → unplanned downtime → contamination risk ↑ → product loss

  Risk of maintenance itself:
    Opening non-routine areas → particle/microbial release → environmental contamination

  Optimal balance:
    Preventive maintenance (PM) > corrective maintenance (CM)
    Gray space design > maintenance inside the cleanroom
    TGSE area isolation > shutdown of the entire cleanroom

  Recovery criteria:
    Triple clean/disinfect → EM confirmation → release

blocks.zh: CDMO 場景：你的潔淨室 B 級區的一台 HVAC 風機需要緊急維修，但目前有兩條充填線正在進行商業批次生產。你決定使用 TGSE 方案。根據 TR90，你的行動計畫應包括：
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: An HVAC fan in your grade B cleanroom needs urgent repair, but two filling lines are currently running commercial batches. You decide to use a TGSE. Under TR90, your action plan should include:

blocks.zh: 劃定 TGSE 範圍並安裝臨時圍封，確保壓差低於周圍 B 級區
blocks.en: Define the TGSE boundary and install a temporary enclosure, ensuring the pressure differential is lower than the surrounding grade B area

blocks.zh: 制定維護人員專用進出動線和更衣程序
blocks.en: Establish a dedicated entry/exit route and gowning procedure for maintenance personnel

blocks.zh: 在 TGSE 周圍增加 EM 取樣點和取樣頻率
blocks.en: Add EM sampling points and increase the sampling frequency around the TGSE

blocks.zh: 增加 TGSE 周圍的清潔消毒頻率
blocks.en: Increase the cleaning and disinfection frequency around the TGSE

blocks.zh: 維修完成後執行 triple-cleaning cycle + EM 確認合格後才能放行該區域
blocks.en: After the repair, perform the triple-cleaning cycle + EM and release the area only after the results are confirmed acceptable

blocks.zh: 所有 EM 數據納入批次紀錄審查
blocks.en: Include all EM data in the batch record review

blocks.zh: 你的工廠是否有 gray space 設計？如果沒有，哪些維護活動最常需要維護人員進入潔淨區？
blocks.en: Does your facility have a gray space design? If not, which maintenance activities most often require maintenance personnel to enter the cleanroom?

blocks.zh: 你的彈性體零件（O-ring、墊圈等）的更換頻率是如何決定的？是基於時間、使用次數還是狀態檢查？
blocks.en: How is the replacement frequency of your elastomeric components (O-rings, gaskets, etc.) determined? Is it based on time, number of uses, or condition inspection?

blocks.zh: 如果 TGSE 周圍的 EM 數據顯示微生物水準上升，你應該啟動哪些因應措施？
blocks.en: If EM data around the TGSE show a rising microbial level, what response actions should you initiate?

blocks.zh: 請解釋為什麼 TR90 要求「持續評估變更管控、工單和其他製程改善的個別或累積效果」對 CCS 的影響。
blocks.en: Explain why TR90 requires "continuous evaluation of the individual or cumulative effects of change control, work orders, and other process improvements," and what this means for the CCS.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 整體性方法 (Holistic Approach)：設備的「設計 → 確效 → 持續管控」必須作為一個完整的鏈條來規劃，三者環環相扣、缺一不可。「已確效」不等於「永遠有效」。
blocks.en: Holistic Approach: Equipment "design, validation, and ongoing control" must be planned as one complete chain; the three are interlinked and none can be omitted. "Validated" does not mean "effective forever."

blocks.zh: 設計決定成本：設備設計階段的投資可以大幅降低後續營運成本和風險。封閉系統、衛生級設計、互鎖機制、Gray space 等設計決策對 CCS 的長期成效影響深遠。
blocks.en: Design drives cost: Investment at the equipment design stage can greatly reduce later operating costs and risks. Design decisions such as closed systems, hygienic design, interlocks, and gray space have a far-reaching impact on the long-term effectiveness of the CCS.

blocks.zh: 清潔確效的侷限性：清潔確效的預測能力受限於測試時機、數量和方法。Biofilm（如 Arthrobacter russicus 可在 3 天內形成）是長期威脅。Clean hold time 管控是關鍵防線。
blocks.en: Limitations of cleaning validation: The predictive power of cleaning validation is limited by test timing, quantity, and methods. Biofilm (e.g., Arthrobacter russicus can form within 3 days) is a long-term threat. Control of clean hold time is the key line of defense.

blocks.zh: 持續管控五大領域：狀態管控、時間管控、完整性管控、正壓管控、轉運管控。每一項都有具體的查核要點。
blocks.en: Five areas of ongoing control: status control, time control, integrity control, positive pressure control, and transfer control. Each has specific checkpoints.

blocks.zh: SUS 與屏障技術：SUS 提供封閉系統優勢但 integrity testing 受限；Barrier technology (Isolator/RABS) 是非封閉操作的首選；Product pathway 需進行 closure risk analysis。
blocks.en: SUS and barrier technology: SUS offer the advantages of a closed system but integrity testing is limited; barrier technology (isolator/RABS) is the preferred option for non-closed operations; the product pathway requires a closure risk analysis.

blocks.zh: 維護的雙面性：維護既是預防污染的手段，也是潛在的污染來源。TGSE 是平衡維護需求與生產連續性的有效工具，但需要嚴格的壓差、動線、EM 管控，以及 triple-cleaning cycle 恢復程序。
blocks.en: The dual nature of maintenance: Maintenance is both a means of preventing contamination and a potential source of it. The TGSE is an effective tool for balancing maintenance needs with production continuity, but it requires strict control of pressure differential, traffic flow, and EM, as well as a triple-cleaning cycle recovery procedure.

blocks.zh: 彈性體管理：O-ring、墊圈等彈性體零件是設備密封的薄弱環節，需要納入預防性維護計畫。Rouging 等表面劣化的早期偵測可避免粒子污染。
blocks.en: Elastomer management: Elastomeric parts such as O-rings and gaskets are the weak link in equipment sealing and must be included in the preventive maintenance program. Early detection of surface degradation such as rouging can prevent particulate contamination.
